summary.en: Choose nested class forms by their need for an enclosing object and local state.
summary.bn: বাইরের অবজেক্ট বা লোকাল মান দরকার কি না দেখে নেস্টেড ক্লাসের ধরন বেছে নাও।

notes: Java 17 permits static declarations in inner classes; Java 16 relaxed earlier restrictions.

sections.title: Place a helper where its dependency is visible
Draw the references before choosing a form
See four forms in three small programs
Use a class body when you need class structure
An enclosing link also affects reachability
Avoid confusing names, instances and capture

examples.title: Static nested helper
examples.explanationHtml: No Shelf instance is needed. The nested type groups a helper name under its owner without an enclosing-object link.

examples.title: Inner class tied to one counter
examples.explanationHtml: Each View reads its enclosing Counter. The qualified construction expression selects which outer object supplies count.

examples.title: Local and anonymous implementations
examples.explanationHtml: LocalRule has a name within main. The anonymous class creates one unnamed implementation at its expression; bonus stays effectively final.

practice.title: Nested range value
practice.statementHtml: Read low high x, all in -100..100 with low no greater than high. Implement a static nested Range class inside Main. Print IN if x is inside the inclusive range, otherwise OUT.
hints: The helper needs its own fields, but no Main object.

practice.title: Local bonus policy
practice.statementHtml: Read base (0..100) and bonus (0..20). Declare a local class implementing IntUnaryOperator and capturing bonus. Print min(100, base+bonus) through its applyAsInt method.

practice.title: Accidental outer retention
practice.statementHtml: A long-lived listener is an inner class of a large window controller. Explain a possible memory-lifetime problem.
practice.answerHtml: The listener keeps an enclosing controller reference. If a long-lived publisher retains the listener, the controller may remain reachable after the window closes. Unregister it or use a static nested listener with only the state it needs.
hints: Draw the path from the publisher to the controller.

practice.title: Choose a nested form
practice.statementHtml: A helper validates one method’s input using a captured limit and has several helper methods. Would you choose a lambda or a local class?
practice.answerHtml: A local class can name several helper methods and implement the validation contract within the method scope. A lambda is suited to one functional-interface operation and does not introduce a class body with named helper members. The captured limit must remain final or effectively final.
hints: Separate a class body from a single function expression.

quiz.prompt: Does constructing Shelf.Label require a Shelf instance?
quiz.explanation: The static nested Label stores its own number and has no implicit Shelf instance.

quiz.prompt: Which enclosing Counter does each inner View read?
quiz.explanation: Each View is attached to the Counter used in its construction.

quiz.prompt: How do the local and anonymous Rule objects transform ten?
quiz.explanation: The local implementation captures bonus; the anonymous implementation doubles.

quiz.prompt: Which construction creates a non-static Inner for an outer object?
quiz.explanation: A non-static member class needs an enclosing instance.

quiz.prompt: What can a static nested class access directly without an outer reference?
options: Static members of its enclosing class
quiz.explanation: Instance fields require an explicit outer object.

quiz.prompt: What restriction applies to captured local variables?
options: They must be final or effectively final
quiz.explanation: Captured local bindings cannot be reassigned.

quiz.prompt: Can an anonymous class declare a constructor by its own name?
options: No; it has no declared class name
quiz.explanation: Use its superclass constructor arguments and instance initializers as appropriate.

quiz.prompt: Inside an anonymous class method, what does this refer to?
quiz.explanation: Unlike a lambda, an anonymous class introduces its own this.

quiz.prompt: When is a static nested helper usually preferable to an inner helper?
options: When no enclosing instance state is needed
quiz.explanation: It avoids an unnecessary enclosing-object dependency.

quiz.prompt: Where can a local class name be used?
quiz.explanation: The local class name follows local scope rules.

keyPoints.en: A static nested class has no implicit enclosing instance.
keyPoints.bn: স্ট্যাটিক নেস্টেড ক্লাসের সঙ্গে বাইরের কোনো অবজেক্ট নিজে থেকে যুক্ত থাকে না।

keyPoints.en: An inner object belongs to a particular enclosing object.
keyPoints.bn: ইনার অবজেক্ট নির্দিষ্ট একটি বাইরের অবজেক্টের সঙ্গে যুক্ত থাকে।

keyPoints.en: A local class keeps a named implementation inside a method.
keyPoints.bn: লোকাল ক্লাস দিয়ে মেথডের ভেতরেই নামসহ ইমপ্লিমেন্টেশন রাখতে পারো।

keyPoints.en: An anonymous class creates one unnamed implementation.
keyPoints.bn: অ্যানোনিমাস ক্লাস দিয়ে নাম না দিয়েই একটি ইমপ্লিমেন্টেশনের অবজেক্ট বানাও।

keyPoints.en: Captured local bindings must remain effectively final.
keyPoints.bn: লোকাল মান ক্যাপচার করলে সেই ভেরিয়েবলে আবার মান অ্যাসাইন কোরো না।

keyPoints.en: Enclosing references can extend object lifetimes.
keyPoints.bn: বাইরের অবজেক্টের রেফারেন্স থাকলে সেটি আরও বেশি সময় মেমরিতে থেকে যেতে পারে।

examQuestions.question: Compare static nested and non-static member classes with construction syntax.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Outer.Helper is constructed as new Outer.Helper() and has no implicit Outer instance. A member Inner is constructed as outer.new Inner() and can read that outer object’s private state. Both forms can have their own fields and methods.

examQuestions.question: Explain effective-final capture with a local discount class.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Read a discount into a local variable and never reassign it. A local class method may use it when calculating a price. Reassigning that local after declaration breaks capture legality. A mutable object referenced by a final local may still change internally; final constrains the binding.

examQuestions.question: Choose a representation for a reusable callback with three helper methods.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Use a named nested or top-level implementation if multiple callers reuse it. Use a local class if it belongs to one operation. An anonymous class can hold helper methods but becomes hard to read when large; a lambda best fits one short functional-interface operation.
